children: The Singapore dollar consolidates against its U.S. counterpart, as traders focus on Middle East developments. Geopolitical tensions remain high, after Iran reiterated its stance on nuclear activities and warned that the Strait of Hormuz would remain vulnerable while sanctions remain in place, MUFG Bank's Lloyd Chan says in a report. The U.S. dollar is flat at 1.2798 Singapore dollars, LSEG data show. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
